description: Named after the guiding North Star, Team Polaris brings together 6 student innovators from India for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Tackling the Earth Information Jukebox challenge, our mission is to turn open Earth observation data into interactive, actionable insights for a sustainable future.
summary:
Project POLARIS: Earth Information Jukebox transforms complex planetary observation streams into an accessible, multi-sensory auditory experience. Directly addressing "The Earth Information Jukebox" challenge, POLARIS bridges NASA's Earth Information Center (EIC) and GIBS datasets with real-time web audio synthesis.

Using an optimized offscreen canvas pipeline (gibsOffscreen.ts), POLARIS extracts high-resolution spatial and thermal data without heavy file downloads. This telemetry feeds directly into a custom Small Language Model (SLM) pipeline and a 16-step spatial sequencer powered by Tone.js, translating environmental variables like sea surface temperature, global carbon, and aerosols into dynamic musical chords, pads, and basslines.

By converting scientific data into sound, POLARIS opens up new, inclusive pathways for environmental education and planetary awareness. Experience the live mission control interface at polaris-earth-jukebox.vercel.app.
details:
Project POLARIS: Earth Information Jukebox

1. Executive Summary & Vision

POLARIS is an accessible, multi-sensory web interface that bridges complex NASA Earth Observation data with real-time web audio synthesis. Directly tackling “The Earth Information Jukebox” challenge, POLARIS transforms scientific data streams—such as sea surface temperature anomalies, atmospheric carbon dioxide, and glacial ice distributions—into intuitive, immersive musical compositions. By turning planetary telemetry into an auditory experience, POLARIS opens innovative, inclusive pathways for environmental education, scientific literacy, and public engagement.

2. Core Architecture & Technology Stack

Built for high-performance execution, POLARIS leverages a modern web stack optimized for smooth rendering and low-latency client-side processing:

  • Framework: Next.js (App Router) with TypeScript.
  • Styling & UI: Tailwind CSS with high-contrast, mission-control aesthetic elements.
  • Audio Engine: Tone.js / Web Audio API for multi-track procedural synthesis.
  • Infrastructure: Hosted on Vercel with a containerized Small Language Model (SLM) backend running on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

3. Key Technical Modules & Subsystems

A. Client-Side NASA GIBS WMTS Pipeline (gibsOffscreen.ts)

  • Zero-Download Architecture: Bypasses heavy multi-gigabyte raw dataset downloads by implementing an active client-side NASA GIBS (Global Imagery Browse Services) Web Map Tile Service (WMTS) pipeline.
  • Multi-Layer Support: Combines a BlueMarble_ShadedRelief_Bathymetry base layer with 9 active observation layers (including SST-ANOM, VIIRS-DNB, OCO2-CO2, NSIDC-ICE, SMAP-L4, MERRA-2 AOD, PACE-CHL, MODIS-LST, and GRACE-FO).
  • Offscreen Spatial Sampler: Utilizes an HTML5 Canvas spatial feature extractor with willReadFrequently pixel buffers to compute real-time Region of Interest (ROI) quadrant means, anomaly deltas, and spatial variance directly on the client.

B. 3D Orthographic Globe Engine (EarthViewport.tsx)

  • Inverse Raycasting: Implements custom inverse Web Mercator-to-Orthographic raycasting on HTML5 Canvas to support smooth drag-rotation, zoom scaling, and hotspot fly-to interpolation without heavy WebGL/Three.js bundle overhead.
  • Render Optimization: Features module-level base-Earth canvas caching, progressive tile streaming with offline fallbacks (/earth.png), and IntersectionObserver/ResizeObserver render gating to eliminate scroll frame drops and dataset-switching latency.

C. Small Language Model (SLM) Pipeline (smlPipeline.ts & /api/sonify)

  • Cloud Inference: Powered by a fine-tuned Small Language Model (polaris-slm / Qwen-2.5-3B GGUF) hosted via Ollama on a dedicated GCP Compute Engine instance (c3-standard-8).
  • Schema Parity & Fallbacks: Enforces strict JSON schema contracts (SlmSonificationInput / SlmSonificationOutput) between AI inference and deterministic mathematical fallback engines to guarantee zero-crash execution.
  • Concurrency & Safety: Configured with server-side circuit breakers, client-side abort signal bindings (req.signal) to cancel stale inference queues, and secure environment isolation (OLLAMA_API_URL).

D. Web Audio Sonification Workstation (SonificationWorkstation.tsx)

  • 16-Step Spatial Sequencer: Translates extracted pixel metrics, thermal distributions, and geospatial color gradients into a multi-track musical composition across Leads, Pads, Basslines, and Pulses.
  • Advanced DSP Chain: Features dynamic Web Audio synthesis graphs (fatsawtooth, triangle, sine, sawtooth, square), a master low-pass filter, and dynamic Tone.Reverb effects.
  • Sanitization & Memory Management: Includes strict pitch-notation sanitization (sanitizeToneNote), polyphony scaling (maxPolyphony: 16), and explicit lifecycle cleanup hooks (.dispose()) to eliminate runtime memory leaks.

4. Mission-Control UI/UX Design

  • Borderless Telemetry HUD: A high-contrast observation interface featuring unboxed inline coordinate/unit readouts and real-time execution logs.
  • Hardware-Styled Controls: Interactive WebGL2-styled action buttons (SONIFY REGION, PLAY/STOP) paired with live multi-phase pipeline progress trackers.
